tagline: Leading provider of health science solutions delivering complete workflows from discovery to cure
hero_kpi_rationale: The Software segment in Life Sciences is the primary growth driver for the segment, with 5% growth in 2025, well above segment average (2%), and reflects a strategic shift toward digital and integrated solutions, notably with AI.

kpis.name: Software Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by software activities in the Life Sciences segment.
kpis.description: Software revenue increased by $35.6M in 2025, driving Life Sciences segment growth.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after deduction of direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined 104 basis points in 2025, impacted by pricing, currency, and product mix.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure from pricing and currency headwinds

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined slightly by 10 basis points, due to gross margin pressure, partially offset by efficiency gains.
kpis.signal: Modest margin pressure despite efficiency gains

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development spending in revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending reached 7.6% of revenue in 2025, up 10% in absolute value, supported by new product development.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 11,000 employees at end of 2025, following workforce reduction measures of approximately 5% related to restructurings.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $12.17B in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $3.4B in latest year

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.14 in latest year

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.033B in latest year

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 13.6% in latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years from 10-K filings.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.241B in latest year

kpis.name: AI Integration
kpis.explanation: Use of artificial intelligence to strengthen products and operational efficiency.
kpis.description: The company is actively integrating AI into its differentiated offerings and internal processes, as indicated in its strategy.

kpis.name: Life Sciences Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth of the Life Sciences segment.
kpis.description: The Life Sciences segment grew 2% in 2025, driven by software (+$35.6M), despite declines elsewhere.

ai_positioning.summary: Revvity adopts an integrator posture regarding AI, progressively embedding it into its differentiated solution offerings and using it to enhance internal operational efficiency. AI is not yet a flagship product, but rather a cross-functional strategic lever.
evidence: Official strategy: 'Advancing the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to further strengthen our differentiated offerings'
Software segment growth, likely supported by digital and AI functionality
R&D investments up 10% for new product development
